name: Scite.ai
tagline: Smart citations for research paper discovery
description: Scite.ai is an AI-powered research tool that shows how research papers have been cited — specifically distinguishing between supporting, contrasting, and mentioning citations. This allows researchers to see not just how many times a paper is cited, but whether subsequent research supported or contradicted its findings. Features include a reference check tool, an AI assistant for literature review, and a journal-level analysis dashboard.
pricingDetails: Free: basic access. Individual: $20/month. Team: custom. University licences available.
